Counterexamples with products {'2026-06-30': {1.588}}: (a) `2026中报含金量为1.588，行业排名第3。` -> residual '，行业排名第3。' -> '3' followed by '。' -> `〔比率对应关系待核对〕` prefixed to a correct, matching value, status completed->partial, the '不能视为已核算结论' notice appended and the single same-turn repair consumed; (b) thousands separators do the same: `2026中报含金量为1.588，同期经营现金流1,234.56亿元[E1]。` -> `_NUMBER` matches '1' before the comma, '，' is not a unit -> same false unknown (the committed controls survive only because 位/亿/个/百分点 happen to be in the unit lexicon). At the reviewed baseline d38dab3f and at 79dba348 a located+matching value produced no finding, so this over-marking is introduced by this commit. It is fail-closed for truth (no wrong number is published and the door states the mark '不证明数字错误，只声明未核准'), which is why it is low rather than medium.
findings.recommendation: Pin the two inputs above as explicit controls and decide the behavior: either require the residual number to sit in a value-ish context (after 为/是/实际为/该值为/比率为 or adjacent to the ratio label) before raising the flag, or record in docs/agent-product-door.md that ANY unresolved digit in the ratio's scope (including thousands-separator fragments and bare ordinals) deliberately produces an unverified mark.

findings.title: The genitive exception in _ratio_scope_end extends one period's scope over a following period whose own ratio is then never evaluated
